I’d like to know why there’s such a delay with the older order and what’s going on with both. Also, for the other order, I need to update the shipping address since I’m moving to a new city before it’s delivered next month. I want to make sure it gets sent to my new address and would like confirmation of the updated total price after the change. Can you help me with all of this at once, please?

For #W8268610, I need to change the shipping address to 1234 Elm St, Springfield, IL, 62701, since I’ll be moving before it’s delivered. Please confirm the address change and let me know the updated total price for that order. 

I’d appreciate it if you could handle all of this together.

Yes, please go ahead and cancel order #W2702727. The reason is “no longer needed” since the wait has been unreasonable. I’d like confirmation that the full $625.60 will be refunded.

For order #W8268610, please update the shipping address to 1234 Elm St, Springfield, IL, 62701. I want to make sure the order will be delivered to my new address and would like confirmation of the total price after the address change—just to be sure nothing changes with the move.

Please confirm both actions for me.

Yes, that’s all correct. Please proceed with cancelling order #W2702727 and updating the shipping address for order #W8268610 as described. Let me know once both actions are completed and confirm the refund and updated order details.
Thank you for confirming everything and handling my requests. That’s all I needed for now.
